title: docs(data-modeling): the `unique` default cell states the type-conditional default
body:
Fixes #14940

## What changed

One cell, one line: the `unique` row of the **Universal Field Properties** table in
`content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` now states the type-conditional default the
schema has applied since #13894 landed (PR #14904, merged 2026-09-03).

- Default cell: `` `false` `` becomes `` `false` (`'organization'` on `autonumber`) `` — the same
  one-token-plus-qualifier voice as the neighbouring default cells.
- Description cell gains one sentence, worded to match the `unique` doc block in `FieldSchema`
  and the `autonumber` callout on the same page: "Omitted ⇒ `false`, except on an `autonumber`
  field, where omitted ⇒ `'organization'` — an auto-number is a business identifier, so the
  platform makes it unique per organization by default; write `unique: false` explicitly to opt out."

`git diff --stat` for this PR: `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx | 2 +-` — 1 insertion, 1 deletion.

## The `autonumber` callout at `:485` / `:493` is deliberately UNCHANGED

The card's opening paragraphs were written against the pre-#13894 tree and are inverted by the
triage (14940#issuecomment-5542748654). The callout's sentence — "an autonumber guarantees a
unique, ever-increasing business identifier" — is **true** against the schema as it stands today,
because an omitted `unique` on an `autonumber` field now materialises as `'organization'`. Editing
or weakening it would delete a true sentence. The only thing the card's own branching left to do is
the table cell, and that is all this PR touches.

## Re-measured on current main before writing the cell

The card's probe (`FieldSchema.safeParse` on a field that omits `unique`) was re-run against
`origin/main` at `4f85e4d11`, through a freshly built `@objectstack/spec`
(`packages/spec/dist/data/index.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, exit 0). The cell's
whole content is what this answers:

```
autonumber (unique omitted)            -> ok=true unique="organization"
autonumber (unique: false explicit)    -> ok=true unique=false
text (unique omitted)                  -> ok=true unique=false
number (unique omitted)                -> ok=true unique=false
```

The card's own reading (`autonumber (unique omitted) -> ok=true unique=false`, taken at `450e73b4`)
is superseded, as the triage said it would be. The materialising line is
`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2115` — `patch.unique = field.type === 'autonumber' ? 'organization' : false;`
— pinned by `packages/spec/src/data/field-autonumber-default-unique.test.ts`.

## Verification

Gate family derived from the change set rather than hand-listed:
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, exit code 0,
which printed:

```
dispatch-gates: gate list derived from the tree of 'objectstack-ai/objectstack' at commit 4f85e4d11
  --repo 'objectstack-ai/objectstack' checked against this checkout's 'origin' remote — it holds.
dispatch-gates: change set derived from git — 1 path(s) vs merge base 4f85e4d11 of 'origin/main' and HEAD
  · content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx
dispatch-gates --commands: 37 command(s) — 25 pnpm, 12 direct node
```

All 37 derived commands were run **after** the final commit, on `b822fdbf0`
(`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), each exit code captured by redirect before any pipe
(`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`). **37 of 37 exit 0.** Verdict lines the gates printed themselves:

```
✅ check-doc-anchors: 305 internal #fragment link(s) across 410 source file(s) all resolve to a real heading
✓ check-doc-frontmatter: 2 content root(s) verified, each against its own floor — content/docs 405, content/blog 3
✓ check-docs-single-h1: 405 page(s) under content/docs/ carry no body-level `# ` heading (0 subtree(s) excluded)
✓ doc authoring guard: 394 files clean — no bare metadata literals.
check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 7502 text file(s) -- 7502 tracked, 0 untracked-not-ignored; skipped 7 binary; no raw ASCII control bytes).
✓ docs-accuracy-audit scope is in sync with content/docs/: 190 hand-written doc(s)
✓ affected-docs self-test: 568 cases pass.
```

`pnpm -s check:pm-dispatch-gates` is **not** in the derived family for this change set and was
therefore not run.

Three gates first answered NOT MEASURED rather than green — recorded as such, then remeasured:
`check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture` exited **3**
(`PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` not built) and
`check:skill-examples` exited **1** on its own prerequisite refusal
(`packages/client-react/dist holds no .d.ts declarations`). After
`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/client-react`
(34 tasks successful, exit 0) all three exit 0. Both builds ran through the shared verify lock
(`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).

One further gate, `pnpm check:docs-audit-scope`, reds on a box where a previous gate in this same
run left `packages/spec/.examples-build-src/` behind — a known, already-filed local run-order
interaction (#15457), unrelated to this diff and reproduced on a clean checkout of `4f85e4d11`
with zero edits, where the same self-test passes. Run on a tree without those gitignored
byproducts it exits 0, as quoted above.

## Changeset

None, and this PR takes `skip-changeset`: it publishes nothing from any released package — the
diff is a single line of `content/docs/**`, consumed only by the private docs app.

## Scope

The scope fence inherited from #14901 is kept: this is the `unique` default cell only, not a sweep
of the Universal Field Properties table. The generated reference page
`content/docs/references/data/field.mdx` carries the AUTO-GENERATED banner and was **not**
hand-edited; its `unique` row was checked and already carries the post-#13894 wording, so there is
no generator staleness to report.
